module: Flowgraph node "Controls Action" (category logic, event). Lets flow through when the action (Ctrl + Space) is pressed. Automatically pushes the "FlowgraphActions" action map when the graph starts and removes it on stop. Pins: flow (input), flow (output, pulse once on press) and value (hidden bool, true on press).
notes: The event is valid if it is less than 2 manager frames old (mgr.frameCount).
Code todo: uncertain interaction if several flowgraphs use this node.

_executionStarted.desc: Resets the state and calls pushActionMap("FlowgraphActions").

_executionStopped.desc: Resets the state and calls popActionMap("FlowgraphActions").

onControlsAction.desc: Hook called when the action is triggered: stores the frame number.

work.desc: Sets flow and value to true during the frame following the press, otherwise to false.
